skills.name: Complete Kill
skills.text: During Jia Xu's turn, only Jia Xu and players on the brink of death can use Peach.

skills.name: Upheaval
skills.text: Once per game, Jia Xu can force all other players to attack a player within their range. If a player does not, they lose one health.

skills.name: Curtain
skills.text: Jia Xu cannot be targeted by black tool cards.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
